screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.unavailable: Lighting shader unavailable. See the client log.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.mod: Refresh the light volume with the smallest per-tick budget.
Refresh the light volume faster with a larger per-tick budget.
Apply local light changes as soon as possible. Uses the largest per-tick budget.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.lig: Render detailed local lighting in loaded chunks within this distance.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.fol: Use the current Minecraft render distance for lighting, up to 32 chunks.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.dis: Maximum distance from a light to a surface. Weaker lights can have a shorter range.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.atm: Show light shafts and weather effects.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.sha: Controls celestial shadow map resolution and the number of samples per luminous block face.
screen.jem_lighting_sandbox.settings.pre: Applies to rain, snow and sand in all biomes.
